title.zh: Kimi K3 (2.8T) at 1 token/s on a MacBook Pro, streamed from four SSDs
title.en: Kimi K3 (2.8T) at 1 token/s on a MacBook Pro, streamed from four SSDs

current_state.zh: A project demonstrates running the Kimi K3 2.8T parameter model at 1 token/s on a MacBook Pro by streaming weights from four SSDs, sparking community discussion on feasibility and hardware limits.
